policy.use: Static profiles classify sector drivers and peer baskets. Only completed candles and point-in-time events public by the simulated click may influence V7.
policy.direction_rule: Directional labels use only intrinsic information available at publication. Ambiguous or mixed announcements are NEUTRAL. Subsequent stock-price action is never used.

ICICIBANK.business: Large Indian private-sector bank with retail, corporate, treasury and fee-income businesses.

TCS.business: Global information-technology services and consulting company with large enterprise transformation exposure.

M&M.business: Indian automotive and farm-equipment group with utility vehicles, tractors and financial-services exposure.

HINDUNILVR.business: Large Indian fast-moving consumer goods company spanning home care, beauty, personal care and foods.

CIPLA.business: Indian pharmaceutical company with India, North America, Africa and emerging-market businesses.

HINDALCO.business: Integrated aluminium and copper producer with global downstream exposure through Novelis.

NTPC.business: Large Indian power generator with thermal generation and expanding renewable-energy capacity.

TITAN.business: Indian consumer company led by jewellery, watches and eyewear with premium discretionary-demand exposure.

ASIANPAINT.business: Large Indian decorative-paints company with home-improvement and international operations.

ADANIPORTS.business: Indian ports and integrated logistics operator with domestic and international cargo exposure.

COALINDIA.business: State-controlled Indian coal producer supplying the power and industrial sectors.

BRITANNIA.business: Indian packaged-foods company led by biscuits, bakery and adjacent food categories.

events.title: TCS reported Q3 revenue growth, stable operating margin, net income growth and a strong order book with expanding AI-services revenue
events.notes: Direction uses only the published Q3 financial and order-book comparisons. Intraday publication time is conservatively shifted to the next NSE session open.

events.title: ICICI Bank reported a year-over-year profit decline and missed consensus after additional supervisory-review provisions, while loan growth and asset quality remained resilient
events.notes: The negative label is based on the reported profit decline, consensus miss and additional provisions, not subsequent market reaction.

events.title: Cipla reported flat consolidated revenue with lower margin pressure from generic Revlimid, alongside strong double-digit India business growth
events.notes: Published strengths and weaknesses are mixed, so no direction is inferred. January 26 is an NSE holiday; the archive uses the next session open.

events.title: Asian Paints published Q3 FY26 consolidated results with modest sales growth and exceptional-item impacts
events.notes: The result contains mixed operating and exceptional-item information; direction is deliberately neutral.

events.title: NTPC disclosed commercial operation of another 130.47 MW part capacity of the Khavda-I solar project
events.notes: Direction reflects incremental commissioned generation capacity only; publication-time ambiguity is handled with next-session-open timing.

events.title: India's 2026-27 budget raised planned infrastructure spending by 11.4% to a record 12.2 trillion rupees, while the allocation was below some market expectations
events.notes: Higher capex is supportive but the announcement was mixed relative to expectations; broad-market direction is therefore neutral.

events.title: Adani Ports reported Q3 revenue up 22%, EBITDA up 20%, PAT up 21% and increased FY26 EBITDA guidance
events.notes: Direction is based only on published growth and guidance, not later share-price movement.

events.title: RBI unanimously held the repo rate at 5.25% and retained a neutral stance amid low inflation and resilient growth
events.notes: The hold and neutral stance are treated as mixed/expected for equities; next-session-open timing is used.

events.title: Titan approved and published its unaudited Q3 FY26 financial results and investor presentation
events.notes: The archive records the result event but does not infer a directional surprise without an unambiguous intrinsic comparison.

events.title: Britannia approved unaudited consolidated and standalone Q3 FY26 financial results
events.notes: No outcome-driven interpretation is applied; the event is retained as neutral.

events.title: Mahindra & Mahindra reported Q3 consolidated revenue up 26% and PAT up strongly with broad operating growth across auto and farm businesses
events.notes: Direction uses only published year-over-year operating and profit growth.

events.title: Hindustan Unilever reported 6% consolidated revenue growth, 4% underlying volume growth and 3% EBITDA growth in the December quarter
events.notes: Direction is based on published underlying sales, volume and EBITDA growth, excluding the exceptional demerger-related PAT effect.

events.title: Hindalco reported consolidated revenue up 14%, EBITDA up 5% and PAT before exceptional items up 8%, with record India-business PAT
events.notes: Direction uses published operating growth before exceptional items and does not use later price reaction.

events.title: India February retail inflation rose to 3.21% from 2.74% in January, slightly above a Reuters poll but still below the RBI's 4% target
events.notes: The higher print and oil risks were offset by inflation remaining below target, so the broad-market label is neutral.
